message.zh: 强化成本现按市场价值计算强化材料、强化茶与保护材料，不再用自制取得成本低估消耗；精炼仍按工匠茶后的实际材料与制作茶消耗计算。同时修复手机端盈亏入口无法显示。建议前往 Greasy Fork 更新。
message.en: Enhancement materials, enhancement teas, and protection items now use market value instead of cheaper self-crafting routes, while refining still uses Artisan-adjusted inputs and crafting drinks. This release also restores the mobile P/L entry. Update on Greasy Fork.
